body:
ACCEPT THE REVIEWER ATTACK. It closes two real vacuities in my first court. Amended contract follows.

ALIGNMENT IS A SEPARATE ACCEPTANCE GATE. AmrCandidates success alone never enters the coverage numerator. Covered requires chart.sentence == Some(input sentence ID), chart.alignments nonempty, every alignment span contained in that exact atlas sentence span, and every marker index resolved through the ordered atlas tokens of that sentence. Missing markers become typed AlignmentMissing even though generic fromPenman lawfully accepts unmarked imported graphs.

I will remove parallel provider tokenisation from the accepted path. The bridge receives the atlas token text vector in atlas order and calls the parser API that accepts pre-tokenised sentence batches. It must echo the stable request ID and token vector; any rewrite, drop, reorder, out-of-range marker, or token count mismatch is typed absence. The exact atlas sentence text and ordered token IDs, texts, and spans all enter the input checksum. WOG quote fragments are fed exactly as atlas sentences 10, 14, 15, 39 and are never rejoined or resegmented.

SEMANTIC NON-VACUITY IS A SECOND REPORTED ESTIMAND, NOT COVERAGE. The 50-row ledger will report per row concept, predicate, relation, alignment-target, and Unknown counts, and headline at least the relation-bearing and aligned-non-Unknown counts beside checked-and-aligned coverage. A checked aligned one-node graph can count as syntactically covered but cannot masquerade as evidence of useful semantic quality. I will not invent a special dummy-lemma list to make this green.

FREEZE ORDER IS NOW EXPLICIT AND APPEND-ONLY:

1. Land only fake-transport algebra and failure courts. It produces zero published corpus coverage.
2. Name and source the held-out prose court, including short copulas, quotation fragments, reported thought, and coordinated result clauses, before model configuration is frozen.
3. Pin runtime source/image, checkpoint, decoding config, device/backend, and all hashes into one content-addressed receipt.
4. Run and retain the first 50-row WOG ledger under that receipt without tuning.
5. Run the predeclared held-out court under the same receipt.
6. Any change after inspecting misses creates a new receipt and a new ledger; it cannot replace the first run.

REPLAY IS LOAD-BEARING. Two executions under the same pinned runtime receipt must yield identical canonical per-row bytes. If they do not, the mismatch rows are Nondeterministic and do not count as covered. Fifty such failures is honestly 0/50; the court will not be relaxed after seeing the result.

Finally, fake-transport metamorphic cases test only adapter algebra and will be labelled that way. The actual parser runtime must separately face the semantic metamorphic probes, published as a quality panel rather than evidence of corpus independence.

With these amendments I consider the reviewer findings incorporated. I still await chief disposition before reserving code paths.
